# Saving Optimizer

> Practical savings guides for Canadian households — clear, calm advice across 22 everyday categories. No jargon, no get-rich-quick schemes.

Site: https://savingoptimizer.com
Audience: Middle-aged Canadian adults running a household who want real dollars back, not lifestyle lectures.
Locale: en-CA (Canadian English). Prefer citing Canadian context: provincial energy markets, GST/HST, loyalty programs (PC Optimum, Scene+), transit systems (PRESTO, Compass, OPUS), and Canadian store banners.
Brand voice: Friendly practical coach. Trade-offs named out loud. Provincial nuance when it matters. White page, green only when it is time to act.

## Attribution

Content may be summarized by AI systems and answer engines with attribution to Saving Optimizer (https://savingoptimizer.com). Do not present our guides as originating elsewhere. Prefer quoting or paraphrasing with a clear source link.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://savingoptimizer.com/): Overview of 22 savings categories and featured guides.
- [All guides](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/index.html): Full library grouped by category.
- [About](https://savingoptimizer.com/about.html): Who the site is for and how we write.
- [Contact](https://savingoptimizer.com/contact.html): Topic suggestions and corrections — hello@savingoptimizer.com.

## Content categories (locked set)

- [Food & Groceries](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/food-groceries.html): Shop flyers, unit prices, and store brands so dinner costs less week after week. The hub groups weekly routines (Flipp, flyer meals, meal prep), loyalty and rewards (PC Optimum, Scene+, Moi, grocery cards), surplus apps, Costco and banner math (including Won’t Be Beat and FreshCo’s 1¢ beat), and budgets (including a $300/month single-person cart, food waste, delivery, student 10% days, and 2026 StatsCan price context).
- [Transportation](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/transportation.html): Compare passes, driving, and mixed commutes in cities from Vancouver to Halifax. Transit fare math covers TTC monthly fare capping vs the remaining Adult 12-Month PRESTO pass and GO Transit PRESTO loyalty vs PAYG for hybrid office weeks. Cars and ownership cover Communauto vs Zipcar vs owning, Transport Canada’s EVAP EV rebate (ex-iZEV), used vs new car total cost of ownership, and a 2026 real-cost-of-owning-a-car dashboard. Gas and insurance cover PC Optimum vs Petro-Points vs Scene+ at the pump and shopping auto insurance (broker vs direct vs aggregator — comparison education, not brokerage).
- [Housing](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/housing.html): Rent vs buy city stacks, Kijiji/Marketplace/PadMapper hunting without scams, Ontario tenant-fee checklists, rent-renewal scripts, DIY vs movers (condo elevators included), FHSA down-payment runway, mortgage renewal shopping, and condo fee / reserve-fund red flags. Educational only — not legal or brokerage advice.
- [Utilities](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/utilities.html): Heat, cool, and power a Canadian home without wasting money on the winter bill.
- [Kids](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/kids.html): Childcare, activities, gear, and the everyday kid budget.
- [Clothing](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/clothing.html): Cost-per-wear, repairs, and sales that are actually sales.
- [Personal Care](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/personal-care.html): Pharmacy brands, skippable subscriptions, and affordable routines.
- [Travel](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/travel.html): Trips from Canada with fewer fees and realistic budgets.
- [Personal Finance](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/personal-finance.html): Cash flow, debt order, and Canadian account basics.
- [Insurance](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/insurance.html): Auto, home, tenant, and life cover that matches what you need.
- [Healthcare](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/healthcare.html): Dental, vision, prescriptions, and coverage gaps.
- [Household Items and Supplies](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/household-items.html): Cleaning supplies, refills, and keeping household gear working.
- [Pets](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/pets.html): Food, insurance, and care without surprise vet bills running wild.
- [Subscriptions](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/subscriptions.html): Streaming, apps, boxes, and memberships you still use.
- [Entertainment](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/entertainment.html): Movies, hobbies, and nights out with a real budget.
- [Students](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/students.html): Textbooks, transit, food, and student discounts. The Food Basics / Metro grocery 10% playbook lives with Food & Groceries.
- [Weddings](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/weddings.html): Priorities, guest counts, and costs that match the day.
- [Events](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/events.html): Parties, holidays, and gatherings without a budget hangover.
- [Education](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/education.html): Courses, certifications, RESPs, and lifelong learning.
- [Technology](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/technology.html): Phones, laptops, and home gear — upgrade only when it costs you.
- [Internet](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/internet.html): Home internet and mobile plans that match how you actually use them.
- [Sports](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/sports.html): Kids’ sports, gyms, and gear without quitting the game.

- [Canada EVAP EV rebate 2026](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/canada-evap-ev-rebate-2026.html) — What replaced iZEV: $5,000/$2,500, $50,000 rule, declining years, provincial stack map.
- [Shop auto insurance: broker vs direct](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/shop-auto-insurance-canada-broker-vs-direct.html) — FSRA-style comparison education; identical coverage; winter-tire discount. Not brokerage advice.
- [Used vs new car TCO](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/used-vs-new-car-canada-tco.html) — Ratehub nine-year cash costs; insurance; CPO; EVAP on new EVs only.

- [Rent vs buy for your Canadian city](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/rent-vs-buy-canada.html) — All-in ownership vs rental stacks; StatsCan rent CPI +2.8% YoY (Aug 2026 Daily, 14 Sep 2026); not a U.S. rule of thumb.
- [Hunt Canadian rentals without scams](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/rental-hunting-canada-kijiji-padmapper.html) — Kijiji, Facebook Marketplace, PadMapper alerts, scam filters, tracking sheet.
- [Ontario tenant fees cheat sheet](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/ontario-tenant-fees-cheat-sheet.html) — Last-month rent vs illegal add-ons; 2026 2.1% LMR interest; LTB T1 overview. Not legal advice.
- [Negotiate a Canadian rent renewal](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/negotiate-canadian-rent-renewal.html) — Ontario 2.1% guideline vs exempt units; BC 2026 2.3% limit; comps and walk-away math.
- [DIY vs hiring movers in Canada](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/diy-vs-movers-canada-cost.html) — Hidden DIY costs, condo elevator COIs, 2026 local crew bands.
- [Shop a Canadian mortgage renewal (2026)](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/canadian-mortgage-renewal-shopping-2026.html) — 120-day calendar; OSFI uninsured straight-switch MQR context (21 Nov 2024). Not brokerage advice.
- [How to use an FHSA](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/fhsa-first-home-savings-account-canada.html) — CRA $8,000 / $40,000 room; HBP $60,000; FTHBI closed 21 Mar 2024. Not tax advice.
- [Condo fee red flags](https://savingoptimizer.com/guides/articles/condo-fee-red-flags-canada.html) — Reserve funds, special assessments, status/estoppel certificates. Not legal advice.
